title: Change the car
description: Pick another free car: of the same category first, or of another one. It must be free for the whole booking.
noFreeCars: No other car is free for the whole booking.
papersLapseHint: Its insurance or road papers run out before the return: renew them before the handover, or it cannot leave.

pricingHint.keep: The customer pays as booked and keeps the booked km terms: a free upgrade, or a cheaper car you settle yourself.
pricingHint.reprice: The rental days are priced again for this car, with its category's km terms and deposit. Extras, fees and discounts keep their amounts.

customerToldHint: This car was booked exactly: the customer is emailed the new car.
